headline: Profits surge from a year ago but ease from last quarter
summary_short: Revenue was $1,232.9M, up 2.6% y/y; diluted EPS of $2.55 rose 44.9% y/y but slipped 5.9% q/q as net income fell 5.0% sequentially to $500.0M.
summary_long: Revenue was $1,232.9M, +2.6% y/y and +1.2% q/q. Operating income of $466.7M fell 6.7% y/y and 1.6% q/q, with operating margin compressing to 37.9% from 41.6% y/y. Net income of $500.0M rose 39.5% y/y but fell 5.0% q/q; diluted EPS of $2.55 followed the same pattern (+44.9% y/y, -5.9% q/q). Cash rose to $259.9M from $134.6M q/q, though still well below the $1,104.6M year-ago level. Long-term debt was $10,180.2M, +4.9% q/q.
